commands.review_summary:
The PR changes `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled` from review-required to automatic repair, wires its Gateway doctor check to the automatic narrower, and adds focused coverage for disabling denied endpoint `enabled` leaves while preserving nested URL-fetch config.

PR surface: Source +10, Tests +58. Total +68 across 5 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a feature PR. Source inspection shows current main detects denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings but does not register a repair handler, while the PR adds that automatic repair path and focused tests.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human handling remains required because the external PR has insufficient real behavior proof and changes a compatibility/security-sensitive automatic repair surface.

target.title: policy: repair denied gateway http endpoints
target.body:
## Summary

- Restack on current `main` after #99720 merged.
- Classify `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled` as an automatic narrowing repair.
- Wire `doctor --fix` to set the exact reported denied Gateway HTTP endpoint `enabled` paths to `false`.
- Leave URL-fetch allowlist findings manual; this PR only disables denied endpoints and preserves nested endpoint config.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` can now repair denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings by disabling the reported endpoint paths while preserving nested endpoint options such as URL-fetch settings.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-policy-gateway-http-push`, source checkout at PR head `1fcd3219f46a81938a91df78856136e30753dbfdb`, based on `upstream/main` `82106a18b3beaaff085ca3258a6f09cd19348d03` after #99720 merged.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD`
2. `git diff --stat HEAD~1..HEAD`
3. `git diff --name-status HEAD~1..HEAD`

Evidence after fix:
`git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` exited 0. The final PR diff is the intended five-file slice: `extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts`, `fix-metadata.ts`, `metadata.test.ts`, `register.test.ts`, and `scopes/gateway.ts`, with 70 insertions and 2 deletions. The new focused test `repairs denied gateway HTTP endpoint findings` covers disabling `chatCompletions` and `responses`, verifies both repair change messages, checks no remaining findings, and verifies nested URL-fetch config remains intact.

Observed result after fix:
The repair path uses `setFindingConfigValues(..., "enabled", false)` for `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled`, so only the reported endpoint `enabled` fields are narrowed. The PR no longer carries the already-merged channel-ingress commits from #99720.

What was not tested:
This clean push worktree has no `node_modules`, so I did not rerun Vitest locally after the final post-#99720 restack. GitHub CI is running on the pushed PR head.

## Stack

- Now directly stacked on `main` after #99720 merged.
- Next downstream slice remains #99776 after this PR is ready.
